descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to be short, shortened, or too short, indicating physical shortness or insufficiency of power, reach, or duration (e.g., 'Is the LORD's hand too short?').
Qal idiomatic sense: of the soul/spirit becoming 'short,' i.e., losing patience, growing weary or vexed — the Hebrew idiom קצרה נפשו meaning 'his soul was short' = he became impatient.
Hifil causative sense: to actively shorten something, to cut short the days or duration of something (e.g., 'You have shortened the days of his youth').
Piel intensive/factitive sense: to curtail or cut short something decisively (e.g., 'He has shortened/cut short the days').
